name: Hajimete no Novel Game
original_name: はじめてのノベルゲーム
source: Hajimete no Novel Game is a game made by Harada Hitomi during her hospitalization in 2015. The free game was created using "[url=http://novelchan.wgt.jp/3878/]Script Shoujo Novel-chan[/url]" application. The game apparently receives a great response, and is renewed using all-new illustrations and is full voiced.
